celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ﴾ in speech and otherwise ﴿مُعْرِضُونَ﴾,

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ﴾ from what is unlawful,

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ﴾ i.e. of their wives, ﴿أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ﴾ i.e. the concubines, ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ﴾ in going in to them;

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿فَمَنِ ابْتَغَى وَرَاءَ ذَلِكَ﴾ of wives and concubines, such as masturbating with his hand, in going in to them, ﴿فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ﴾ those who transgress into what is not lawful for them;

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ﴾ plural and singular ﴿وَعَهْدِهِمْ﴾ among themselves, or between them and Allah, of prayer and other things, ﴿رَاعُونَ﴾ keepers;

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَوَاتِهِمْ﴾ plural and singular ﴿يُحَافِظُونَ﴾ perform them at their times;

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ﴾ which is the highest garden of the Gardens; ﴿هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ﴾. In that is an allusion to the Return, and fitting to it is the mention of the Beginning after it.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿وَ﴾ by Allah, ﴿لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ﴾ Ādam ﴿مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ﴾ it is from "salaltu the thing from the thing", i.e. I extracted it from it, and it is its quintessence; ﴿مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سلالة».

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاهُ﴾ i.e. man, the offspring of Ādam, ﴿نُطْفَةً﴾ semen ﴿فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ﴾ which is the womb;

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً﴾ congealed blood, ﴿فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً﴾ a piece of flesh the size of what is chewed, ﴿فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا﴾; and in one reading [عَظْمًا] in both places; and «خلقنا» in the three places is in the sense of «صيّرنا» (We made [it] become). ﴿ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا آخَرَ﴾ by breathing the spirit into it. ﴿فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ﴾ i.e. of those who shape; and the tamyīz (specification) of «أحسن» is omitted because it is known, i.e. "in creating".

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ﴾ for the reckoning and the recompense.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَائِقَ﴾ i.e. heavens, plural of ṭarīqa, because they are the paths of the angels; ﴿وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ﴾ beneath them ﴿غَافِلِينَ﴾ [lest] they fall upon them and destroy them; rather We hold them, as in the verse: {وَيُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءَ أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ}.

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ﴾ of their sufficiency, ﴿فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ذَهَابٍ بِهِ لَقَادِرُونَ﴾ so that they would die of thirst along with their animals.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿فَأَنْشَأْنَا لَكُمْ بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ﴾ these two are the most common fruits of the Arabs; ﴿لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ﴾ summer and winter,

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَ﴾ We produced ﴿شَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سِينَاءَ﴾ a mountain; with kasra on the sīn and with fatḥa [سَيْنَاءَ]; it is a diptote because of being a proper name and feminine, [referring] to the spot; ﴿تُنْبِتُ﴾ from the four-letter [verb], and from the three-letter [تَنْبُتُ], ﴿بِالدُّهْنِ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) on the first [reading] and transitivising on the second; and it is the olive tree; ﴿وَصِبْغٍ لِلْآكِلِينَ﴾ conjoined to «الدهن», i.e. a relish that colours the morsel when it is dipped in it, and it is the oil.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ﴾ camels, cattle and sheep ﴿لَعِبْرَةً﴾ a lesson from which you take heed: ﴿نَسْقِيكُمْ﴾ with fatḥa on the nūn and with ḍamma [نُسْقِيكُمْ] ﴿مِمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا﴾ i.e. milk, ﴿وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ﴾ of wool, fur, hair and other things, ﴿وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ﴾,

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَعَلَيْهَا﴾ i.e. the camels ﴿وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ﴾ i.e. the ships ﴿تُحْمَلُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ obey Him and affirm His oneness; ﴿مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ﴾ it is the noun (ism) of «ما», what precedes it is the khabar (predicate), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); ﴿أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ﴾ fear His punishment for your worshipping other than Him?

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾ to their followers: ﴿مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَفَضَّلَ﴾ to gain eminence ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ by being followed while you are his followers. ﴿وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ that none other than He be worshipped, ﴿لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً﴾ with that, not a human being. ﴿مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا﴾ which Nūḥ calls to, of the affirmation of oneness, ﴿فِي آبَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ i.e. the past nations.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿إِنْ هُوَ﴾ Nūḥ is not ﴿إِلَّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ﴾ a state of madness, ﴿فَتَرَبَّصُوا بِهِ﴾ wait for him ﴿حَتَّى حِينٍ﴾ until the time of his death.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ Nūḥ: ﴿رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي﴾ against them ﴿بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ﴾ i.e. because of their denying me, by destroying them. Allah the Exalted said, answering his supplication:

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ﴾ the ship ﴿بِأَعْيُنِنَا﴾ in Our sight and under Our protection ﴿وَوَحْيِنَا﴾ Our command; ﴿فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا﴾ for their destruction ﴿وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ﴾ the baker's [oven], with water; and that was a sign for Nūḥ; ﴿فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا﴾ i.e. put into the ship ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجَيْنِ﴾ i.e. male and female, i.e. of all their kinds, ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾ a male and a female; it is the mafʿūl (object), and «من» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اسلك». In the story [it is related] that Allah the Exalted gathered for Nūḥ the beasts of prey, the birds and others, and he began striking with his hands among every kind, and his right hand would fall on the male and his left on the female, and he would carry them into the ship. And in one reading [كُلٍّ] with tanwīn, so «زوجين» is the mafʿūl and «اثنين» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of it. ﴿وَأَهْلَكَ﴾ i.e. his wife and children, ﴿إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ﴾ of destruction, namely his wife and his son Kanʿān, unlike Sām, Ḥām and Yāfith; so he carried them and their wives, three [of them]. And in Sūrat Hūd: {وَمَنْ آمَنَ وَمَا آمَنَ مَعَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ}; it is said they were six men and their women, and it is said that all who were in the ship were seventy-eight, half of them men and half of them women. ﴿وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا﴾ disbelieved, [asking] that they not be destroyed; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿فَإِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ﴾ are settled ﴿أَنْتَ وَمَنْ مَعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the disbelievers, and [by] their destruction.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿وَقُلْ﴾ when you disembark from the ship: ﴿رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا﴾ with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the zāy, a maṣdar (verbal noun) or a noun of place; and with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the zāy, the place of landing; ﴿مُبَارَكًا﴾ that landing or place, ﴿وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ﴾ of what was mentioned.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned of the affair of Nūḥ, the ship and the destruction of the disbelievers ﴿لَآيَاتٍ﴾ indications of the power of Allah the Exalted; ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy [inna], and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); ﴿كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ﴾ testing the people of Nūḥ by sending him to them and by his admonition.

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا﴾ a people ﴿آخَرِينَ﴾ they are ʿĀd.

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ﴾ Hūd, ﴿أَنِ﴾ i.e. "that" [bi-an] ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ﴾ His punishment, and so believe?

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ﴾ i.e. the passage to it, ﴿وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ﴾ We gave them comfort ﴿فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ﴾

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿وَ﴾ by Allah, ﴿لَئِنْ أَطَعْتُمْ بَشَرًا مِثْلَكُمْ﴾: in it are an oath and a condition, and the answer belongs to the first of them and dispenses with the answer of the second; ﴿إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا﴾ i.e. if you obey him ﴿لَخَاسِرُونَ﴾ i.e. cheated.

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنْتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَنَّكُمْ مُخْرَجُونَ﴾ it is the khabar (predicate) of the first «أنكم», and the second «أنكم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of it, because the separation grew long.

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ﴾ a verbal noun (ism fiʿl) of the past, in the sense of a maṣdar, i.e. far, far [it is] ﴿لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ﴾ of being brought out of the graves; and the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for clarification.

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿إِنْ هِيَ﴾ i.e. life is not ﴿إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا﴾ through the life of our sons, ﴿وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿إِنْ هُوَ﴾ i.e. the messenger is not ﴿إِلَّا رَجُلٌ افْتَرَى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ believing in the Resurrection after death.

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ﴾ of time, and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), ﴿لَيُصْبِحُنَّ﴾ they will surely become ﴿نَادِمِينَ﴾ over their disbelief and denial.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ the cry of punishment and destruction, being ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ and they died; ﴿فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَاءً﴾ which is withered plants, i.e. We made them like it in dryness. ﴿فَبُعْدًا﴾ from mercy ﴿لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the deniers.

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا﴾ by dying before it, ﴿وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ﴾ beyond it; the pronoun is made masculine after being feminine, out of regard for the meaning.

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرًا﴾ with tanwīn and without it: in succession, with a long time between every two. ﴿كُلَّمَا جَاءَ أُمَّةً﴾ with both hamzas pronounced fully, and with the second softened between it and wāw, ﴿رَسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضًا﴾ in destruction ﴿وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْدًا لِقَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ a clear proof, which is the hand, the staff and other signs,

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾ from believing in them and in Allah, ﴿وَكَانُوا قَوْمًا عَالِينَ﴾ overpowering the Children of Israel with oppression.

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿فَقَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ﴾ obedient, submissive?

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ﴾ the Torah, ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ i.e. his people, the Children of Israel, ﴿يَهْتَدُونَ﴾ by it from error; and he was given it after the destruction of Pharaoh and his people, all at once.

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ﴾ ʿĪsā ﴿وَأُمَّهُ آيَةً﴾; He did not say "two signs" because the sign in them both is one: his birth without a male. ﴿وَآوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَى رَبْوَةٍ﴾ an elevated place, which is Jerusalem, or Damascus, or Palestine: [several] opinions; ﴿ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ﴾ i.e. level, on which its inhabitants settle, ﴿وَمَعِينٍ﴾ i.e. flowing water on the surface, which the eyes see.

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ﴾ the lawful things, ﴿وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا﴾ of obligatory and supererogatory; ﴿إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ﴾ and I shall recompense you for it.

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿وَ﴾ know ﴿أَنَّ هَذِهِ﴾ i.e. the religion of Islam ﴿أُمَّتُكُمْ﴾ is your religion, O you who are addressed, i.e. you must hold to it, ﴿أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً﴾ a permanent ḥāl (circumstantial); and in one reading with the nūn lightened, and in another [وَإِنَّ] with kasra and doubled, as a new sentence (istiʾnāf); ﴿وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ﴾ so beware of Me.

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿فَتَقَطَّعُوا﴾ i.e. the followers ﴿أَمْرَهُمْ﴾ their religion ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تقطعوا», i.e. differing factions, like the Jews, the Christians and others; ﴿كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ﴾ i.e. what they have of religion ﴿فَرِحُونَ﴾ pleased.

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿فَذَرْهُمْ﴾ i.e. leave the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ﴾ their error ﴿حَتَّى حِينٍ﴾ i.e. until the time of their death.

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ﴾ We give them ﴿مِنْ مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ﴾ in this world

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿نُسَارِعُ﴾ We hasten ﴿لَهُمْ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ﴾? No! ﴿بَلْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ that this is a gradual leading on [to ruin] for them.

celaleyn:57-57.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ their fear of Him ﴿مُشْفِقُونَ﴾ afraid of His punishment,

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ the Qurʾān ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ believe,

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ anything else with Him,

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ﴾ give ﴿مَا آتَوْا﴾ what they gave, of charity and righteous deeds, ﴿وَقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ﴾ fearful that it will not be accepted from them, ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ the genitive lām is implied before it, ﴿إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ﴾,

celaleyn:61-61.t: ﴿أُولَئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ﴾ in the knowledge of Allah.

celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا﴾ i.e. its capacity; so whoever cannot pray standing, let him pray sitting, and whoever cannot fast, let him eat. ﴿وَلَدَيْنَا﴾ i.e. with Us ﴿كِتَابٌ يَنْطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ with what it [the soul] has done, and it is the Preserved Tablet, in which deeds are recorded; ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ i.e. the souls that act ﴿لَا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾ in anything of them, so nothing is reduced from the reward of good deeds, nor is anything added to the evil deeds.

celaleyn:63-63.t: ﴿بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ i.e. of the disbelievers ﴿فِي غَمْرَةٍ﴾ ignorance ﴿مِنْ هَذَا﴾ Qurʾān, ﴿وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِنْ دُونِ ذَلِكَ﴾ which was mentioned for the believers, ﴿هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ﴾ and they will be punished for them,

celaleyn:64-64.t: ﴿حَتَّى﴾ inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya) ﴿إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِمْ﴾ their rich men and chiefs ﴿بِالْعَذَابِ﴾ i.e. the sword on the day of Badr, ﴿إِذَا هُمْ يَجْأَرُونَ﴾ they clamour. It is said to them:

celaleyn:65-65.t: ﴿لَا تَجْأَرُوا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُمْ مِنَّا لَا تُنْصَرُونَ﴾ you will not be protected.

celaleyn:66-66.t: ﴿قَدْ كَانَتْ آيَاتِي﴾ of the Qurʾān ﴿تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنْكِصُونَ﴾ you would go back, retreating,

celaleyn:67-67.t: ﴿مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ﴾ from faith, ﴿بِهِ﴾ i.e. by the House or the Sanctuary, since its people are in security, unlike the rest of people in their homelands; ﴿سَامِرًا﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. a group conversing at night around the House; ﴿تَهْجُرُونَ﴾ from the three-letter [verb]: you abandon the Qurʾān; and from the four-letter [verb], i.e. you say what is not true about the Prophet and the Qurʾān. Allah the Exalted said:

celaleyn:68-68.t: ﴿أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا﴾ its origin is «يتدبروا», and the tāʾ was assimilated into the dāl, ﴿الْقَوْلَ﴾ i.e. the Qurʾān, which indicates the truthfulness of the Prophet, ﴿أَمْ جَاءَهُمْ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِ آبَاءَهُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾

celaleyn:69-69.t: ﴿أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:70-70.t: ﴿أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ﴾ the question in it is for affirmation (taqrīr) of the truth: of the truthfulness of the Prophet, of messengers having come to past nations, of their knowing their messenger for truthfulness and trustworthiness, and that there is no madness in him. ﴿بَلْ﴾ for transition, ﴿جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ i.e. the Qurʾān, which contains the affirmation of oneness and the laws of Islam, ﴿وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:71-71.t: ﴿وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ﴾ i.e. the Qurʾān ﴿أَهْوَاءَهُمْ﴾ by bringing what they desire, of a partner and a child for Allah (exalted is Allah above that), ﴿لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ﴾ i.e. would depart from their observed order, because of the mutual obstruction that ordinarily exists in a thing when rulers are many. ﴿بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ﴾ i.e. the Qurʾān, in which is their mention and their honour; ﴿فَهُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ مُعْرِضُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:72-72.t: ﴿أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا﴾ a wage for the faith you have brought them? ﴿فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ﴾ His wage, reward and provision ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾; and in one reading [خَرْجًا] in both places, and in another reading [خَرَاجًا] in both; ﴿وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ﴾ the most excellent of those who give and reward.

celaleyn:73-73.t: ﴿وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ﴾ path ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ i.e. the religion of Islam.

celaleyn:74-74.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ in the Resurrection, reward and punishment, ﴿عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ﴾ i.e. the path ﴿لَنَاكِبُونَ﴾ deviate.

celaleyn:75-75.t: ﴿وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِنْ ضُرٍّ﴾ i.e. a famine that struck them in Mecca for seven years, ﴿لَلَجُّوا﴾ they would persist ﴿فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ﴾ their error, ﴿يَعْمَهُونَ﴾ wandering to and fro.

celaleyn:76-76.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ﴾ the famine, ﴿فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا﴾ they did not humble themselves ﴿لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ﴾ turn eagerly to Allah in supplication,

celaleyn:77-77.t: ﴿حَتَّى﴾ inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya) ﴿إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا ذَا﴾ possessing ﴿عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ﴾ it is the day of Badr, with killing, ﴿إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ﴾ despairing of all good.

celaleyn:78-78.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَ﴾ created ﴿لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ﴾ in the sense of «الأسماع» (hearings) ﴿وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ﴾ the hearts; ﴿قَلِيلًا مَا﴾ emphasising the littleness ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:79-79.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ﴾ created you ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ﴾ you will be resurrected.

celaleyn:80-80.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي﴾ by breathing the spirit into the lump of flesh ﴿وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ﴾ in darkness and light, and in increase and decrease. ﴿أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ His handiwork, the Exalted, and so take heed?

celaleyn:81-81.t: ﴿بَلْ قَالُوا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْأَوَّلُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:82-82.t: ﴿قَالُوا﴾ i.e. the ancients: ﴿أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ﴾? No! In the two hamzas in both places there is full pronunciation and softening of the second, and inserting an alif between them, in both ways.

celaleyn:83-83.t: ﴿لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَآبَاؤُنَا هَذَا﴾ i.e. resurrection after death ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ﴾ not ﴿هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ﴾ the lies ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ like jokes and marvels; plural of usṭūra, with ḍamma.

celaleyn:84-84.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿لِمَنِ الْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهَا﴾ of creatures, ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ its Creator and Owner?

celaleyn:85-85.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ with assimilation of the second tāʾ into the dhāl: take admonition, and so know that the One who is able to create in the first place is able to bring to life after death; [تَذْكُرُونَ].

celaleyn:86-86.t: ﴿قُلْ مَنْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ﴾ the Kursī (Footstool)?

celaleyn:87-87.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُونَ اللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ﴾ beware of worshipping other than Him?

celaleyn:88-88.t: ﴿قُلْ مَنْ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ﴾ the dominion ﴿كُلِّ شَيْءٍ﴾, and the tāʾ is for intensity (mubālagha), ﴿وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ﴾ protects, and none is protected against Him, ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾?

celaleyn:89-89.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُونَ اللَّهُ﴾ and in one reading [لِلَّهِ] with the genitive lām, in both places, in view of the meaning being "to whom does what was mentioned belong". ﴿قُلْ فَأَنَّى تُسْحَرُونَ﴾ are you deceived and turned away from the truth, the worship of Allah alone, i.e. how is it made to seem to you that it is false?

celaleyn:90-90.t: ﴿بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the truth ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ﴾ in denying it; and it is:

celaleyn:91-91.t: ﴿مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِذًا﴾ i.e. had there been a god with Him, ﴿لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ﴾ i.e. kept it to himself and prevented the other from taking control of it, ﴿وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ﴾ in contest, as the kings of this world do. ﴿سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ﴾ declaring Him free ﴿عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ﴾ Him with, of what was mentioned,

celaleyn:92-92.t: ﴿عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ﴾ what is absent and what is witnessed; in the genitive (majrūr) as an adjective (ṣifa), and in the nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of «هو» implied (muqaddar); ﴿فَتَعَالَى﴾ He is exalted ﴿عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ with Him.

celaleyn:93-93.t: ﴿قُلْ رَبِّ إِمَّا﴾ in it is the assimilation of the nūn of conditional «إن» into redundant «ما»; ﴿تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ﴾ of punishment — it came true with the killing at Badr —

celaleyn:94-94.t: ﴿رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ so that I perish by their destruction.

celaleyn:95-95.t: ﴿وَإِنَّا عَلَى أَنْ نُرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:96-96.t: ﴿ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾ i.e. the trait of forgiving and turning away from them ﴿السَّيِّئَةَ﴾ their harming you; and this was before the command to fight. ﴿نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ﴾ i.e. lie and say, and We shall recompense them for it.

celaleyn:97-97.t: ﴿وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ﴾ I take refuge ﴿بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ﴾ their promptings with what they whisper,

celaleyn:98-98.t: ﴿وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ﴾ in my affairs, because they come only with evil.

celaleyn:99-99.t: ﴿حَتَّى﴾ inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya) ﴿إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ﴾ and he sees his seat in the Fire and his seat in the Garden had he believed, ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ﴾ the plural is for magnification,

celaleyn:100-100.t: ﴿لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا﴾ by bearing witness that there is no god but Allah, which would be ﴿فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ﴾ wasted of my life, i.e. in exchange for it. Allah the Exalted says: ﴿كَلَّا﴾ i.e. there is no return. ﴿إِنَّهَا﴾ i.e. "My Lord, send me back" ﴿كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَائِلُهَا﴾ and there is no benefit for him in it; ﴿وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ﴾ before them ﴿بَرْزَخٌ﴾ a barrier keeping them from returning ﴿إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ and there is no return after it.

celaleyn:101-101.t: ﴿فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ﴾ the horn, the first blast or the second, ﴿فَلَا أَنْسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ which they boast of ﴿وَلَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ﴾ about them, contrary to their state in this world, because of the enormity of the matter that occupies them from that at some stations of the Resurrection; and at some of them they come to, and in a verse: {فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ}.

celaleyn:102-102.t: ﴿فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ﴾ with good deeds, ﴿فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾ the winners;

celaleyn:103-103.t: ﴿وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ﴾ with evil deeds, ﴿فَأُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ so they are ﴿فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:104-104.t: ﴿تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ﴾ burns them, ﴿وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ﴾ their upper lips drawn up and the lower [hanging loose] away from their teeth.

celaleyn:105-105.t: And it is said to them: ﴿أَلَمْ تَكُنْ آيَاتِي﴾ of the Qurʾān ﴿تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ you were warned by them, ﴿فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ﴾?

celaleyn:106-106.t: ﴿قَالُوا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا﴾ and in one reading [شَقَاوَتُنَا] with fatḥa on its first letter and an alif; both are maṣdars (verbal nouns) with one meaning; ﴿وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَالِّينَ﴾ from guidance.

celaleyn:107-107.t: ﴿رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا﴾ to disobedience ﴿فَإِنَّا ظَالِمُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:108-108.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ to them, through the tongue of Mālik, after [a period] twice the length of the world: ﴿اخْسَئُوا فِيهَا﴾ be gone into the Fire, abased, ﴿وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ﴾ about lifting the punishment from you; and so their hope is cut off.

celaleyn:109-109.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي﴾ they are the Emigrants (al-Muhājirūn), ﴿يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾

celaleyn:110-110.t: ﴿فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سُخْرِيًّا﴾ with ḍamma on the sīn and with kasra [سِخْرِيًّا]: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of mockery; among them were Bilāl, Ṣuhayb, ʿAmmār and Salmān; ﴿حَتَّى أَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِي﴾ so you abandoned it, because you were occupied with mocking them; they were the cause of the forgetting, so it is attributed to them; ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:111-111.t: ﴿إِنِّي جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ﴾ with lasting bliss ﴿بِمَا صَبَرُوا﴾ on your mockery of them and your harming them; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ with kasra on the hamza ﴿هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ﴾ in what they sought: a new sentence (istiʾnāf); and with fatḥa [أَنَّهُمْ], the second mafʿūl (object) of «جزيتهم».

celaleyn:112-112.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ the Exalted, to them, through the tongue of Mālik, and in one reading [قُلْ]: ﴿كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ in the world and in your graves, ﴿عَدَدَ سِنِينَ﴾ tamyīz (specification)?

celaleyn:113-113.t: ﴿قَالُوا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ﴾ they were in doubt about that and thought it short because of the enormity of the punishment they are in; ﴿فَاسْأَلِ الْعَادِّينَ﴾ the angels who count the deeds of creatures.

celaleyn:114-114.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ the Exalted, through the tongue of Mālik, and in one reading also [قُلْ]: ﴿إِنْ﴾ i.e. not ﴿لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the extent of your stay; its length was little in comparison with your stay in the Fire.

celaleyn:115-115.t: ﴿أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا﴾ not for a wise purpose, ﴿وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تَرْجِعُونَ﴾ in the active, and in the passive [تُرْجَعُونَ]? No; rather, so that We might bind you in servitude with command and prohibition, and you return to Us and We recompense for that: {وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ}.

celaleyn:116-116.t: ﴿فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ﴾ above frivolity and anything else unbefitting Him, ﴿الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ﴾ the Kursī; it is the beautiful throne.

celaleyn:117-117.t: ﴿وَمَنْ يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ﴾ a descriptive adjective (ṣifa kāshifa) with no contrary implication (mafhūm); ﴿فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ﴾ his recompense ﴿عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ﴾ they will not be happy.

celaleyn:118-118.t: ﴿وَقُلْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ﴾ the believers; in mercy there is something beyond forgiveness; ﴿وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾ the most excellent of those who show mercy.
